## SwitcherGrid

Displays the App Switcher (multitasking) screen as Apple's own iPad-style grid instead of the default horizontal carousel — no custom layout code, just Apple's own built-in switcher style.

- Forces the App Switcher into Apple's native iPad-style grid layout
- Swipe down on any card to kill every open app at once, with a staggered cascading animation and haptic feedback
- Opening an empty switcher (no running apps) instantly returns to the Home Screen
- Settings.app panel with independent toggles for the grid style and the swipe-down-to-kill-all gesture
- A Respring button in Settings to apply a grid style change
The App Switcher builds its layout once per Respring, so toggling the grid style requires tapping Respring in Settings for it to take effect.

## 1.0.0
- Initial release
- Grid App Switcher via Apple's own SBAppSwitcherSettings style switch
- Swipe down on any card to kill all open apps, staggered with haptic feedback
- Instant return to Home Screen when the switcher opens with no running apps
- Settings.app panel with live toggles and a manual Respring button
